en: Multi-view color postcard with four photographs of landmarks in the city of Pécs. The upper-left shows an ornate historic building on a street with several 1970s–1980s Eastern Bloc cars parked in front. The upper-right image depicts a central square at dusk with a domed former mosque, a tall column, an equestrian statue, and parked cars. The lower-left shows greenery with trees and a round stone ruin or tower. The lower-right image features a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four towers and a prominent statue in front, surrounded by flower beds and old buildings. In the center of the front side, on an orange band, is the caption "PÉCS". The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, a Hungarian stamp, postmark, and printed publisher information.
